summary: Implements Number.isSafeInteger in its own file. It checks ops::is_integral_number on the argument, then tests abs(n) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991.0 (2^53-1, the spec constant), and returns true or false per steps 1 and 2. No observable conversions are required by the spec and none are added. Errors are propagated correctly (the function has no fallible steps). Only the target file changes. The duplicated step comments (original stub block plus new comments above the code) are cosmetic.
